recorded.prompt:q-cut:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-cut:a: "Widening any other arc changes nothing." s->A is not in the cut.
recorded.prompt:q-cut:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-cut:c: "every cut's capacity bounds the flow". A->B does not cross the cut {A->t, B->t}, so that cut still caps the flow at 40. This takes one step of inference.
recorded.prompt:q-cut:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-cut:d: "Widening any other arc changes nothing." No arc out of s is in the cut.
recorded.prompt:q-unbalanced:a: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-unbalanced:a: "80 on hand, 70 wanted: solve() -> UNBALANCED"; a surplus needs a shelf node.
recorded.prompt:q-unbalanced:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-unbalanced:b: The status for supplies that don't sum to 0 is UNBALANCED, not INFEASIBLE.
recorded.prompt:q-unbalanced:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-unbalanced:d: solve() returns UNBALANCED, not OPTIMAL, when supplies don't balance.
recorded.prompt:q-shortfall:b: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-shortfall:b: Table: when demand cannot all be shipped, this call 'ships less'. INFEASIBLE is solve()'s outcome, not this call's.
recorded.prompt:q-shortfall:c: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-shortfall:c: 'it ships 60 of the 80 wanted, at $259k'. A short delivery has a nonzero cost.
recorded.prompt:q-shortfall:d: Using only what the lesson page states, does a passage of the page rule this option out? Cite the passage, or say none does or that the option is partly true. Be strict.
recorded.outcome:q-shortfall:d: '80 on hand, 70 wanted ... OPTIMAL, 70 shipped' and the 60-of-80 case show that OPTIMAL does not mean all units arrived.
